items.title: India’s Social Security Coverage
items.summary: 31 OCT 2026 9:46AM by PIB Delhi India’s social security framework has expanded through wider EPFO coverage, digital reforms and welfare initiatives. EPFO provides provident fund savings, pension and insurance benefits to eligible members. The increase in the mandatory coverage wage ceiling from ₹15,000 to ₹25,000 is expected to bring over 51 lakh additional employees within its ambit.

facts.text: The increase in the mandatory coverage wage ceiling from ₹15,000 to ₹25,000 is expected to bring over 51 lakh additional employees within its ambit.
The scheme offers insurance benefits of up to ₹7 lakh, without requiring members to pay a separate insurance premium.
Contributing members rose from 3.49 crore in 2014-15 to approximately 7.98 crore (as on 16 September, 2026).
This represents an increase of approximately 4.49 crore contributing members over the period.
